messages.subject: Remove Outliers in Boxplot
parts:
Dear All,
I am pretty new to ggplot2, but I am already quite impressed, though
it will be hard work to master it.
Consider a very simple boxplot

qplot(color, price / carat, data = diamonds, geom = "boxplot")

I would like to plot the same data without the outliers and in such a
way that the y axis re-adjusted automatically (i.e. not the same
figure without outliers; I would be wasting space with the same range
in y).
Can anyone help me out here?
Many thanks

Lorenzo
